title: Tag paper-v1 on neurips-rebuttal
description: Tag `paper-v1` on `neurips-rebuttal`; push to backup remote(s); verify tag SHA is preserved outside the repo (e.g. cluster README; external doc).

title: Scan git history for PHI/secrets
description: `git log --all -p` scan for PHI/tokens/keys across history; enable GitHub secret scanning + push protection; document any incidents and remediation.

title: Create trained_models_inventory.csv
description: Produce `trained_models_inventory.csv` (path; size; model; dataset; run_id; retention_tier; sha256) covering all of `trained_models/` and `experiments/`. Classify into paper-critical / active-work / archivable / deletable.

title: Choose storage target and write mirror script
description: Choose object-storage target (institutional S3; HF private repo; or cluster mirror); write mirror script; dry-run on paper-critical subset.

title: Cherry-pick rebuttal analyses to main
description: Cherry-pick/rebase `scripts/analysis/rebuttal_neurips2026/` + `src/evaluation/storage.py` deltas from `neurips-rebuttal` to `main` via a documented PR series; keep `METHODOLOGY.md` in the tree.

title: Add AGENTS.md and read-only path declarations
description: Add repo-root `AGENTS.md` (mirrored as `CLAUDE.md`) declaring read-only paths (`trained_models/`; `cache/data/*/`; `experiments/`; `results/`; `mlflow/`); add per-directory `.agent-forbidden` markers where appropriate.

title: Enable branch protection and security features
description: Enable branch protection on `main` (required review; no force push; required checks); add `CODEOWNERS`; enable Dependabot + secret scanning + Copilot review on PRs.

title: Archive or delete stale branches
description: Snapshot list of 50+ branches; tag `archive/<branch-name>` for anything not merged; open a tracking issue for delete-after-2-weeks.

title: Design single experiment architecture
description: One-page RFC choosing a single meaning for "experiment" (recommend: `configs/` declarative → `src/pipelines/` runners → `runs/` outputs) and mapping the four current experiment folders onto it. No code change yet — just the decision.

title: Create private fork and document sync policy
description: Create private mirror/fork; document sync policy (upstream → fork nightly; fork → upstream via curated PRs only); move active branches into private.

title: Design and ship ModelAdapter protocol
description: Design the ~150 LoC `ModelAdapter` protocol (fit/predict/save/load + config schema + metadata); ship as `src/models/adapter.py`; port 1 model to it as reference (recommend Chronos-2 or naive baseline first).

title: Introduce Pydantic v2 schemas for all configs
description: Introduce Pydantic v2 schemas for model configs; sweep configs; data configs; evaluation configs; validate on load; auto-generate JSON schema for docs; migrate all existing YAML in `configs/`.

title: Define run_manifest.json schema
description: Define `run_manifest.json` written by every training/eval run (code SHA; data version; seed; hyperparameters; budget metrics; environment fingerprint); wire into existing 3-tier storage.

title: Add Optuna + MLflow tuning implementation
description: Add `src/tuning/` implementation on top of Optuna + MLflow; support pruning; distributed workers; and re-use existing YAML search spaces via Pydantic; automatic search-space + budget table generation (LaTeX + Markdown).

title: Wire MLflow tracking into all entrypoints
description: Wire MLflow tracking into every training/eval entrypoint; capture manifest; artifacts; metrics; document self-hosted server operations.

title: Promote rebuttal stats to first-class modules
description: Promote `scripts/analysis/rebuttal_neurips2026/` A1–A9 into `src/evaluation/stats/` as first-class importable modules with unit tests + CI job that runs the fast ones on sample data on every PR.

title: Unify four experiment folders
description: Execute the RFC from `experiments-arch-rfc`; unify `experiments/`; `src/experiments/`; `configs/experiments/`; `scripts/experiments/` into the chosen layout; keep symlinks or shim modules for backward compat for 1 release.

title: Build HF-hostable benchmark
description: Build the HF-hostable benchmark: `datasets` loader for public splits; evaluation script contract; leaderboard-ready output schema; publish a private draft first.

title: Create HF Space leaderboard
description: HF Space that reads leaderboard CSV from a datasets repo; simple table + CD diagram; instructions for benchmark submission.

title: Relicense code to Apache-2.0
description: Relicense code to Apache-2.0. Update `LICENSE`; `pyproject.toml` classifiers; per-file headers; README license section. Publish a `RELICENSE_NOTES.md` explaining the split: code Apache-2.0 / each dataset under its own upstream license / leaderboard entries CC-BY-4.0 / Gluroo data explicitly off-limits.

title: Remove in-progress artifacts from public repo
description: Remove/relocate anything that makes the public repo look "in use": scratch scripts; temp files; in-flight notebook dumps; competition submission CSVs; verify against `.gitignore`.

title: Single mkdocs site for four audiences
description: Single mkdocs site with four audiences (user; contributor; adapter-author; benchmark-submitter); retire `docs-internal/`; archive exploratory notebooks to a separate research-notebooks repo.

title: Add lockfile and seed policy
description: Introduce `uv` (or pip-tools) lockfile; document seed policy; add reproducibility CI job that installs from lockfile and runs smoke tests.

title: Containerize model families
description: Docker/Singularity image per model family + one CPU-baselines image; publish to a container registry; wire into HF Space + local dev.

title: Abstract launcher for Slurm/cloud/local
description: Slurm/cloud/local launcher abstraction (Ray; Modal; or custom); Colab-friendly examples.

title: Track and collapse transformers versions
description: Track upstream `transformers` compatibility; collapse per-model envs when possible.

title: Optional W&B mirror for paper artifacts
description: Optional W&B mirror for polished reviewer/paper artifacts.
